name: mocharc

schema.description: A JSON schema describing a .mocharc.[json|yml|yaml] file
schema.title: Mocha JS Configuration File Schema

description:
Our test runner is set to not allow uncaught exceptions (allow‑uncaught: false) and to operate in async‑only mode (async‑only: true). It will not bail after the first failure (bail: false) but it will check for memory leaks (check‑leaks: true) and will not introduce an artificial delay before starting (delay: false). The process is configured to exit automatically when the suite finishes (exit: true). Tests that are marked as .only are permitted (forbid‑only: false) while pending tests are forbidden (forbid‑pending: true). The global variable list contains just “myGlobalVar”. Parallel execution is enabled with four worker jobs (jobs: 4, parallel: true). Each test may be retried up to two times (retries: 2). Tests taking longer than 75 ms are considered slow (slow: 75) and the overall timeout per test is 2000 ms (timeout: 2000). The UI style is BDD (ui: “bdd”), colour output is on (color: true), diffs are shown (diff: true) and inline diffs are enabled (inline‑diffs: true). Full stack traces are disabled (full‑trace: false) and Growl notifications are turned off (growl: false). The reporter is set to “spec” with the option “output=report.txt” (reporter‑option: output=report.txt). The configuration file used is ./mocha.opts (config) and the package manifest is ./package.json (package).  

The test files are recognized with the extensions “.js” and “.ts” (extension), and a setup script located at test/setup.js (file) is required before execution. The runner will ignore the node_modules directory (ignore) but will recurse into subdirectories (recursive: true). It loads the modules @babel/register and ts-node/register (require). Test order is not sorted (sort: false) and watch mode is disabled (watch: false); however, the watch file pattern is test/**/*.js (watch‑files) and the watch ignore pattern remains node_modules (watch‑ignore). Test selection can be narrowed with fgrep “TODO” (fgrep) and grep “feature” (grep), without inverting the match (invert: false). The spec pattern is test/**/*.spec.js (spec). Source‑map support is enabled (enable‑source‑maps: true).
